author: Raffles, 1822
habitat: 울창하고 습한 숲, 숲속 개울가, 숲 가까운 풀밭과 논밭
summary: 국내에서는 2006년 6월 전북 군산 시내에서 고양이에게 다친 채 발견된 한 마리가 첫 기록인 길잃은새이다. 인도, 중국 남부, 타이완, 동남아시아, 필리핀, 일본 류큐 제도 남부에 걸쳐 살며, 북쪽 무리 가운데 일부는 겨울에 남쪽으로 옮겨 간다. 주로 해 질 녘부터 새벽 사이에 숲 바닥이나 풀밭을 천천히 걸으며 지렁이를 즐겨 잡고 개구리, 두꺼비, 곤충 따위도 먹는다. 낮에는 빽빽한 숲이나 대숲 속에 숨어 쉰다.

points.en: blue bare skin on the lores and around the eye
rufous sides of the head and neck

points.ko: 날 때 보이는 첫째날개깃 끝의 흰색
points.en: white tips to the primaries, visible in flight

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같다. 번식기에는 수컷의 댕기가 조금 더 길고 눈앞 피부가 더 짙은 파란색을 띤다는 보고가 있다.

young: 어른새와 전혀 달리 몸 윗면이 어두운 갈색 바탕에 흰 점과 담황색 물결무늬가 촘촘하고, 검은 머리꼭대기와 댕기에도 흰 점이 있으며, 아랫면은 흰 바탕에 갈색 점과 가로무늬가 빽빽하다. 자라면서 눈 둘레에 옅은 파란 피부가 드러난다.

similar.how: 붉은해오라기는 머리꼭대기가 적갈색이고 눈앞이 파랗지 않으며 날개깃 끝이 적갈색이지만, 푸른눈테해오라기는 머리꼭대기와 댕기가 검고 눈 둘레가 파라며 첫째날개깃 끝이 희다.

art.subject: Malayan Night Heron (Gorsachius melanolophus), adult: crown and short crest black; sides of the head and neck rich rufous-chestnut; back and wing coverts chestnut-brown finely vermiculated with black; throat white with a black stripe down the centre of the foreneck; underparts buffy-rufous with bold black-and-white streaks and spots down the centre; flight feathers black, the primaries tipped white. Bill short, thick and dark; bare lores and skin around the eye vivid blue; iris yellow; legs and feet greenish.
art.pose: standing still on a shaded forest floor with the neck drawn in, side view
art.scene: damp, shaded broadleaf forest floor on a southern Korean island during spring migration, leaf litter and ferns; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing hunched with the neck drawn in: blackish crown and crest, rufous sides of the head and neck, blue bare lores and eye-ring, yellow iris, short stocky dark bill, chestnut-brown back and wing coverts, olive legs

adult in flight seen squarely from above: head, short neck, body and tail in one line, broad rounded wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, chestnut-brown coverts, dark flight feathers with white tips to the primaries, blackish crown, legs projecting beyond the short tail
art.build: Small, stocky, short-necked heron, smaller than a Black-crowned Night Heron, thickset with a large rounded head carrying a short black crest. Bill noticeably short for a heron, shorter than the head, thick, with a slightly arched culmen. Legs medium length and sturdy. Wings broad and rounded; in flight black flight feathers with white tips to the primaries show against the chestnut coverts. Tail short. Stands hunched and motionless in shade.
avoid: Do not paint a chestnut crown without a black crest — that is Japanese Night Heron (Gorsachius goisagi); this species has a black crown and crest.
Do not give it a long dagger-like heron bill or a long neck; both are short.
Do not paint the grey back and white nape plumes of Black-crowned Night Heron.
Do not leave out the blue bare skin around the eye.
